title: 🔥 WHO OWNS THE BIBLE? DID PROTESTANTS COPY IT FROM THE CATHOLIC CHURCH?
paragraphs:
🔥 WHO OWNS THE BIBLE? DID PROTESTANTS COPY IT FROM THE CATHOLIC CHURCH?
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I’ve heard Catholics say that they own the Bible and that Protestants just copied it. Is this true? Did the Catholic Church give us the Scriptures?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people believe this because the Catholic Church claims authority over the Bible, but the truth may surprise you!

📖 Isaiah 40:8 (KJV)
"The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand forever."

🚨 THE TRUTH:
✔️ The Bible is NOT owned by any church—it is GOD’S WORD, given to His people!
✔️ The Scriptures existed LONG BEFORE the Roman Catholic Church was ever established!
✔️ The Catholic Church actually HID and RESTRICTED the Bible from the people for centuries!
🔥 DID THE CATHOLIC CHURCH CREATE THE BIBLE, OR HAVE THEY TRIED TO CONTROL IT?
💡 QUESTION: Is your faith based on church traditions, or on the unchangeable Word of God?
🚀 NOW LET’S BREAK THIS DOWN WITH SCRIPTURE AND HISTORY!
THE BIBLE EXISTED BEFORE THE CATHOLIC CHURCH!

Many Catholics claim that the Roman Catholic Church "gave us" the Bible and that without them, we wouldn’t have God’s Word. But historical FACTS and SCRIPTURE show that the Bible existed LONG BEFORE the Catholic Church and was preserved by God Himself!

📖 Isaiah 40:8 (KJV)
"The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand forever."
🔥 THE TRUTH: The Bible is ETERNAL—it is not owned by any religious institution!
🚨 LET’S DIG EVEN DEEPER INTO THE FACTS:

✅ 1. THE OLD TESTAMENT WAS ALREADY COMPLETE BEFORE JESUS’ TIME!
🔥 The Catholic Church did NOT write or preserve the Old Testament—God entrusted it to the Jewish people!

📖 Romans 3:1-2 (KJV)
"What advantage then hath the Jew? Or what profit is there of circumcision? Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God."

✔️ The Old Testament was written between 1500 BC and 400 BC.
✔️ God gave His Word to Israel, NOT to Rome!
✔️ Jesus and His apostles used the Hebrew Scriptures—NOT Catholic traditions!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If the Catholic Church claims to own the Bible, why did Jesus confirm the Jewish Scriptures instead of Catholic traditions?
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church didn’t exist in the Old Testament, how can they claim they "own" the Bible?

✅ 2. THE NEW TESTAMENT WAS WRITTEN BY THE APOSTLES—NOT THE CATHOLIC CHURCH!
🔥 Catholics claim they "gave us" the New Testament, but the early Christians already recognized these writings as inspired by God!

📖 2 Timothy 3:16 (KJV)
"All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness."

✔️ The apostles wrote the New Testament under the inspiration of the Holy Spirit!
✔️ By the end of the first century, all 27 books were already being read, copied, and spread among believers.
✔️ The early church fathers quoted these writings long before the Catholic Church claimed to have "canonized" them.
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Catholic Church did NOT write or authorize the New Testament—it was ALREADY accepted by true believers!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church didn’t write the New Testament, why do they claim ownership of it?

✅ 3. EARLY CHRISTIANS ALREADY KNEW WHICH BOOKS WERE SCRIPTURE!
🔥 The idea that the Bible needed a Catholic council to be "official" is false!

📖 1 Thessalonians 2:13 (KJV)
"For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe."

✔️ Church councils did NOT create the Bible—they only recognized what God had already established!
✔️ By the early 2nd century, Christians were already quoting the four Gospels and Paul’s letters as Scripture.
✔️ The Council of Nicaea (325 AD) and the later Councils did not "decide" the Bible—THEY ONLY CONFIRMED what Christians had already accepted!
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Catholic Church did NOT "give" us the Bible—they only acknowledged what God had ALREADY declared as His Word!
💡 QUESTION: If the Bible was already known among Christians, why does the Catholic Church claim they "made" it?

✅ 4. EARLY CHRISTIANS REJECTED MANY CATHOLIC BELIEFS!
🔥 If the Catholic Church "gave us" the Bible, why do so many of its doctrines contradict Scripture?

📖 Mark 7:7 (KJV)
"Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men."

✔️ The early Christians did NOT pray to Mary or saints.
✔️ They did NOT believe in purgatory, indulgences, or the rosary.
✔️ There was NO pope in the early church—Jesus alone was the head of the church!
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Catholic Church added MANY unbiblical traditions—if they truly "owned" the Bible, why do they teach things that contradict it?
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church was the source of the Bible, why do so many of its doctrines go against what Scripture teaches?

✅ 5. THE ROMAN CATHOLIC CHURCH DIDN’T FORM UNTIL CENTURIES LATER!
🔥 How can the Catholic Church claim ownership of the Bible if they didn’t even exist as an institution until centuries later?

📖 Matthew 16:18 (KJV)
"And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it."

✔️ Jesus founded HIS church—not the Roman Catholic Church!
✔️ The early Christians were persecuted by the Roman Empire—how could they be the same as the later Catholic Church?
✔️ The papacy, indulgences, and Marian doctrines were added hundreds of years later!
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Bible was already in use among believers before the Roman Catholic system ever existed!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church didn’t exist when the Bible was being written, how can they claim to own it?
🚀🔥 NOW THAT WE’VE PROVEN THE BIBLE EXISTED BEFORE THE CATHOLIC CHURCH, LET’S EXPOSE HOW THEY TRIED TO CONTROL IT!

HOW THE CATHOLIC CHURCH TRIED TO CONTROL THE BIBLE!
Many people assume that the Catholic Church preserved and protected the Bible, but history reveals a shocking truth: For centuries, the Catholic Church actually worked to keep the Bible away from the people!

📖 John 8:32 (KJV)
"And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free."
🚨 THE FACTS REVEAL THAT THE CATHOLIC CHURCH DIDN’T "GIVE" US THE BIBLE—THEY TRIED TO SUPPRESS IT!
🔥 HERE ARE 5 WAYS THE CATHOLIC CHURCH ATTEMPTED TO CONTROL GOD’S WORD!

✅ 1. THE CATHOLIC CHURCH FORBID COMMON PEOPLE FROM READING THE BIBLE!
🔥 If the Catholic Church "gave us" the Bible, why did they keep it locked away?

📖 Luke 11:52 (KJV)
"Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered."

✔️ For centuries, the Catholic Church prohibited laypeople from reading the Bible.
✔️ In the Middle Ages, only priests were allowed to interpret Scripture.
✔️ People were told that the Bible was "too difficult" for them to understand.
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Catholic Church feared that if people read the Bible for themselves, they would see the lies of Rome!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church "gave us" the Bible, why did they forbid people from reading it?

✅ 2. THE CHURCH KEPT THE BIBLE IN LATIN TO PREVENT ACCESS!
🔥 For over 1,000 years, the Catholic Church insisted that the Bible only be read in Latin—so that common people could not understand it!

📖 1 Corinthians 14:9 (KJV)
"So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken?"

✔️ The Bible was originally written in Hebrew and Greek, the languages of the people.
✔️ The Catholic Church forced the Bible to remain in Latin, which only priests could read.
✔️ This prevented everyday Christians from knowing what the Bible actually said!
🚨 THE TRUTH: God’s Word was meant for ALL people, not just religious leaders!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church "protected" the Bible, why did they make it unreadable for the common man?

✅ 3. PEOPLE WERE KILLED FOR TRANSLATING THE BIBLE!
🔥 When faithful men tried to translate the Bible into common languages, the Catholic Church persecuted and executed them!

📖 John 16:2 (KJV)
"They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service."

✔️ John Wycliffe (1300s) translated the Bible into English—his bones were later dug up and burned as punishment!
✔️ William Tyndale (1500s) printed the Bible in English—he was strangled and burned at the stake!
✔️ Martin Luther (1500s) translated the Bible into German—the Catholic Church tried to have him executed!
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Catholic Church did not "give" us the Bible—they murdered those who made it available to the people!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church truly honors the Bible, why did they kill those who translated it?

✅ 4. THE CATHOLIC CHURCH ADDED EXTRA BOOKS TO SCRIPTURE!
🔥 In the 1500s, the Catholic Church added "Apocryphal" books that were NEVER recognized by the Jews or early Christians.

📖 Proverbs 30:6 (KJV)
"Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar."

✔️ The Apocrypha (Tobit, Maccabees, Judith, etc.) was never accepted by Jesus or the apostles.
✔️ The Catholic Church added these books at the Council of Trent (1546 AD) to justify unbiblical doctrines.
✔️ These books promote false teachings like purgatory and praying for the dead!
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Catholic Church altered the Bible to fit their traditions!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church truly gave us the Bible, why did they change it?

✅ 5. THE CHURCH TAUGHT THAT TRADITION IS ABOVE SCRIPTURE!
🔥 The Catholic Church teaches that their man-made traditions hold equal—or even GREATER—authority than the Bible!

📖 Mark 7:13 (KJV)
"Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye."

✔️ The Catholic Catechism states that "Sacred Tradition and Sacred Scripture make up a single sacred deposit of the Word of God" (CCC 80).
✔️ This allows them to introduce false teachings that are NOT in the Bible (purgatory, indulgences, papal authority, etc.).
✔️ They claim the church can "interpret" Scripture as they see fit—even if it contradicts the actual Word of God!
🚨 THE TRUTH: God’s Word stands ALONE—it does not need man’s traditions to give it authority!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church truly believes the Bible, why do they place their traditions above it?

The Catholic Church claims they "gave us" the Bible, but history proves the opposite! For centuries, they worked to keep the Bible OUT of the hands of the people and to ensure only priests and popes could interpret it.

📖 John 8:32 (KJV)
"And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free."
🚨 BUT INSTEAD OF TEACHING THE TRUTH, THEY HID IT!
🔥 HERE ARE EVEN MORE WAYS THE CATHOLIC CHURCH ATTEMPTED TO CONTROL GOD’S WORD!

✅ 6. THE CHURCH FORCED PEOPLE TO RELY ON PRIESTS INSTEAD OF GOD’S WORD!
🔥 Instead of allowing believers to study the Bible, the Catholic Church taught that only PRIESTS had the authority to interpret Scripture.

📖 1 Timothy 2:5 (KJV)
"For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus."

✔️ The Bible teaches that Jesus is our only mediator—NOT priests, popes, or religious leaders!
✔️ Catholicism kept people spiritually blind by telling them they "needed" the Church to understand Scripture.
✔️ This gave the Vatican FULL control over doctrine—because people couldn’t check the Bible for themselves!
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Catholic Church didn’t give us the Bible—they HID it so they could have power over the people!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church gave us the Bible, why do they still insist that only priests can interpret it?

✅ 7. THE CATHOLIC CHURCH TRIED TO DESTROY PROTESTANT BIBLES!
🔥 Once the Protestant Reformation began, and the Bible was being translated into common languages, the Catholic Church went on a rampage to destroy these Bibles!

📖 Jeremiah 36:23 (KJV)
"And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire."

✔️ In the 1500s, the Catholic Church BANNED translations of the Bible in English, German, and other languages.
✔️ They burned copies of the English Tyndale Bible and later tried to stop the King James Bible (1611).
✔️ The Jesuits even plotted to destroy the Protestant movement and prevent people from reading the Bible!
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Catholic Church tried to WIPE OUT Protestant Bibles—how can they claim they "gave" us the Bible when they worked so hard to DESTROY it?
💡 QUESTION: Why did the Catholic Church burn Bibles if they truly honored God’s Word?

✅ 8. THE INDEX OF FORBIDDEN BOOKS – THE CHURCH BANNED THE BIBLE!
🔥 Did you know that the Catholic Church had an official list of banned books—and the Bible was one of them?

📖 Acts 4:18-19 (KJV)
"And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus. But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye."

✔️ The "Index Librorum Prohibitorum" (List of Forbidden Books) was created by the Catholic Church to ban books they didn’t approve of.
✔️ The Bible in common languages was placed on this list because they didn’t want people reading it freely!
✔️ This list lasted for over 400 YEARS (1559–1966)!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If the Catholic Church "gave us" the Bible, why did they BAN it from being read by common people?
💡 QUESTION: Why would a church that supposedly "gave us" the Bible try to stop people from reading it?

✅ 9. THE CHURCH PUNISHED THOSE WHO PREACHED THE BIBLE WITHOUT PERMISSION!
🔥 The Catholic Church did not just suppress Bible translations—they also punished preachers who taught from the Bible without church approval!

📖 Amos 8:11 (KJV)
"Behold, the days come, saith the Lord God, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord."

✔️ Men like Jan Hus and John Wycliffe were declared heretics for teaching the Bible.
✔️ During the Spanish Inquisition, many were tortured or burned alive for preaching Scripture!
✔️ In some Catholic-controlled regions, it was ILLEGAL to teach the Bible without the Church’s permission.
🚨 THE TRUTH: If the Catholic Church really "gave us" the Bible, why did they persecute those who preached from it?
💡 QUESTION: If the Bible belongs to all believers, why did the Catholic Church claim exclusive control over it?

✅ 10. THE CATHOLIC CHURCH STILL TRIES TO CLAIM AUTHORITY OVER THE BIBLE TODAY!
🔥 Even now, the Vatican claims that the Catholic Church has the final say on interpreting Scripture.

📖 Matthew 15:9 (KJV)
"But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men."

✔️ The Catholic Catechism (CCC 119) teaches that "the task of interpreting the Word of God authentically has been entrusted solely to the Magisterium (Pope and Bishops)".
✔️ This means Catholics are still told they cannot understand the Bible without the Church’s authority!
✔️ Rome continues to teach that tradition is EQUAL to (or even above) the authority of Scripture.
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Catholic Church still wants to control the Bible instead of letting God’s Word speak for itself!
💡 QUESTION: If the Bible is truly God’s Word, why does the Catholic Church insist that only THEY can interpret it?
🚀🔥 NOW THAT WE’VE EXPOSED HOW THE CATHOLIC CHURCH TRIED TO CONTROL THE BIBLE, LET’S SEE HOW GOD USED THE PROTESTANT REFORMATION TO RESTORE THE TRUTH!

HOW THE PROTESTANT REFORMATION RESTORED THE TRUTH OF THE BIBLE!
After centuries of Catholic control over the Bible, God raised up bold men of faith to break the chains of deception and bring His Word back to the people!

📖 Psalm 119:130 (KJV)
"The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple."
🔥 THE PROTESTANT REFORMATION WAS A MOVEMENT TO BRING THE BIBLE BACK TO THE PEOPLE!
🚨 HERE’S HOW GOD USED THE REFORMATION TO RESTORE THE TRUTH!

✅ 1. MARTIN LUTHER REJECTED CATHOLIC CONTROL OVER SCRIPTURE!
🔥 Luther was a Catholic monk who discovered the truth in the Bible and exposed the lies of the Church!

📖 Romans 1:17 (KJV)
"The just shall live by faith."

✔️ Luther realized that salvation is by FAITH ALONE—not by works, indulgences, or the Pope!
✔️ He wrote the 95 Theses (1517), exposing the Catholic Church’s false teachings.
✔️ He translated the Bible into German so common people could read it!
🚨 THE IMPACT: The Reformation began as people saw that the Bible contradicted Catholic doctrines!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church gave us the Bible, why did Luther have to translate it for the people?

✅ 2. WILLIAM TYNDALE GAVE THE ENGLISH-SPEAKING WORLD THE BIBLE!
🔥 Tyndale was one of the first to translate the Bible into English—he was executed for it!

📖 2 Timothy 2:9 (KJV)
"Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound."

✔️ Tyndale’s translation allowed everyday people to read God’s Word for themselves.
✔️ The Catholic Church arrested him, strangled him, and burned his body in 1536!
✔️ His last words: "Lord, open the King of England’s eyes!"
🚨 THE IMPACT: Tyndale’s Bible later influenced the King James Version (1611), which became the world’s most influential Bible!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church gave us the Bible, why did they kill those who translated it?

✅ 3. THE PRINTING PRESS MADE THE BIBLE AVAILABLE TO EVERYONE!
🔥 Before the 1400s, Bibles were copied by hand—but God used technology to spread His Word!

📖 Matthew 24:14 (KJV)
"And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come."

✔️ Johannes Gutenberg invented the printing press in the 1400s.
✔️ One of the FIRST books printed was the Bible!
✔️ This helped spread the Scriptures like never before—beyond the Catholic Church’s control!
🚨 THE IMPACT: Now the Bible could reach the world, and people could see the truth for themselves!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church truly honored the Bible, why did they fight to control who could read it?

✅ 4. THE KING JAMES BIBLE (1611) BROUGHT THE WORD OF GOD TO THE ENGLISH-SPEAKING WORLD!
🔥 The Catholic Church fought against it, but God preserved His Word!

📖 Isaiah 55:11 (KJV)
"So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void."

✔️ The King James Bible was based on faithful Greek and Hebrew manuscripts.
✔️ It was NOT controlled by the Catholic Church—it was a true translation of God’s Word!
✔️ Despite Catholic opposition, it became the most widely read Bible in history!
🚨 THE IMPACT: The KJV helped spread the true Gospel worldwide, outside Catholic control!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church "gave us" the Bible, why did they oppose the King James Version?

✅ 5. THE REFORMATION DESTROYED THE LIE THAT ONLY PRIESTS CAN UNDERSTAND THE BIBLE!
🔥 One of the greatest victories of the Reformation was that people learned they didn’t need a pope or priest to interpret Scripture!

📖 1 John 2:27 (KJV)
"But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you."

✔️ The Holy Spirit teaches believers directly—no pope or priest is needed!
✔️ The Reformation exposed the Catholic Church’s false claim to be the "gatekeepers" of Scripture.
✔️ People realized that God’s Word belongs to EVERYONE, not just religious leaders!
🚨 THE IMPACT: Christians were free to read and interpret the Bible for themselves, as God intended!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following man’s traditions, or are you letting the Holy Spirit reveal truth through God’s Word?

The Catholic Church did not give us the Bible—they tried to control it! But God always preserves His Word, and through the Protestant Reformation, the chains of religious deception were broken, and the Bible was given back to the people!

📖 Matthew 5:18 (KJV)
"For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled."
🔥 THE BIBLE IS INDESTRUCTIBLE—NO CHURCH CAN CONTROL IT!
🚨 HERE ARE EVEN MORE WAYS THE REFORMATION RESTORED THE TRUTH!

✅ 6. THE REFORMATION ENDED THE DARK AGE OF CATHOLIC CONTROL OVER SCRIPTURE!
🔥 For over 1,000 years, the Catholic Church kept the world in "spiritual darkness" by restricting access to the Bible. The Reformation changed that!

📖 2 Corinthians 4:6 (KJV)
"For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ."

✔️ The Middle Ages (5th-15th century) were called "The Dark Ages"—not just because of war and famine, but because the truth of God’s Word was hidden!
✔️ The Catholic Church forced people to depend on priests and popes instead of Scripture.
✔️ The Protestant Reformation (1500s) broke this darkness, bringing the Bible back to the people!
🚨 THE IMPACT: Once people could read the Bible, they saw that Catholic teachings were full of lies!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church "gave us" the Bible, why did the world enter a spiritual "Dark Age" under their rule?

✅ 7. PROTESTANTS REJECTED THE CATHOLIC CHURCH’S FALSE "APOCRYPHA"
🔥 One of the ways the Catholic Church tried to corrupt Scripture was by adding unbiblical books. The Reformation removed them!

📖 Revelation 22:18-19 (KJV)
"For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book."

✔️ The Catholic Church added the Apocrypha (Tobit, Judith, Maccabees, etc.) in 1546 to defend false doctrines like purgatory.
✔️ These books were NEVER considered Scripture by Jesus, the apostles, or the early church.
✔️ The Protestant Reformation restored the true 66 books of the Bible, rejecting Catholic corruption!
🚨 THE IMPACT: The Reformation gave us back the pure Word of God, without Catholic distortions!
💡 QUESTION: If the Catholic Church "gave us" the Bible, why did they add books that Jesus never used?

✅ 8. THE REFORMATION EXPOSED THE CATHOLIC CHURCH’S FALSE GOSPEL!
🔥 Catholicism taught salvation by works, indulgences, and sacraments—but the Bible teaches salvation by FAITH ALONE!

📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 (KJV)
"For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast."

✔️ The Catholic Church said people had to earn salvation through works, penance, and indulgences.
✔️ The Bible reveals that salvation is a FREE GIFT from God, not something we earn!
✔️ The Protestant Reformation shattered the false gospel of Rome and restored the truth of salvation by grace alone!
🚨 THE IMPACT: Millions left the Catholic Church and turned back to the true Gospel of Jesus Christ!
💡 QUESTION: Are you trusting in man-made religion, or in Christ alone for your salvation?

✅ 9. THE REFORMATION RESTORED THE BIBLICAL PRIESTHOOD OF BELIEVERS!
🔥 The Catholic Church teaches that only priests can approach God, but the Reformation restored the biblical truth that ALL believers are priests before God!

📖 1 Peter 2:9 (KJV)
"But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light."

✔️ The Catholic Church claimed that only priests could forgive sins, administer sacraments, and interpret Scripture.
✔️ The Bible teaches that ALL believers have direct access to God through Jesus Christ!
✔️ The Reformation rejected the false Catholic priesthood and restored the biblical priesthood of all believers.
🚨 THE IMPACT: People no longer needed a corrupt priesthood—they could go straight to Jesus Christ!
💡 QUESTION: Are you relying on a church system, or do you have a personal relationship with Christ?

✅ 10. THE REFORMATION LED TO WORLDWIDE MISSIONS AND REVIVAL!
🔥 With the Bible finally free from Catholic control, missionaries carried God’s Word to the nations!

📖 Matthew 28:19-20 (KJV)
"Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost."

✔️ Before the Reformation, Catholicism dominated Europe—but true Christianity was suppressed.
✔️ Once the Bible was restored, the Gospel exploded across the world!
✔️ Protestant missionaries carried God’s Word to Africa, Asia, the Americas, and beyond!
🚨 THE IMPACT: The Reformation didn’t just change Europe—it spread biblical Christianity across the GLOBE!
💡 QUESTION: Are you part of the mission to spread God’s Word, or are you letting tradition keep you in bondage?
🚀🔥 NOW THAT WE KNOW THE TRUTH, HOW SHOULD WE RESPOND? WILL WE STAND FOR THE PURE WORD OF GOD?

THE FINAL WARNING – WILL YOU STAND FOR THE TRUE BIBLE OR FOLLOW MAN-MADE RELIGION?
💭 THE MOMENT OF DECISION IS HERE!
Now that you know the truth, you must ask yourself: Will I stand for the pure Word of God, or will I continue to follow the religious traditions of men?

📖 Revelation 22:18-19 (KJV)
"For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book."

🚨 THE REALITY:
✔️ The Catholic Church tried to control the Bible, but God preserved His Word!
✔️ False religion will never defeat the truth of Scripture!
✔️ Jesus is coming soon, and He is calling His people OUT of religious deception!
🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
💡 QUESTION: Will you trust in God’s unchanging Word, or will you continue following man-made traditions?

🚨 MANY ARE STILL DECEIVED BY THE CATHOLIC CHURCH TODAY!
📖 2 Timothy 4:3-4 (KJV)
"For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears; And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables."

🚨 THINK ABOUT THIS:
❌ Many people still believe the Catholic Church "gave us" the Bible, despite overwhelming evidence to the contrary.
❌ Many are blinded by traditions that contradict Scripture.
❌ Some would rather follow religion than seek the truth for themselves!

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ You must decide whether to follow TRUTH or TRADITION.
✔️ You must reject religious deception and embrace the Bible as your FINAL authority.
✔️ You must stand boldly for God’s Word, even if others oppose you!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you choose religion over truth, you are rejecting God’s Word!
💡 QUESTION: Are you ready to reject false religion and stand for the pure Word of God?

🔥 THIS MAY BE YOUR LAST WARNING!
The truth has been spoken. You cannot unread this or pretend you never heard it.

🚨 WHAT WILL YOU DO NOW?
❌ Ignore it and continue in deception?
